claim_scope: Source review motivates hypotheses and bounds. No native model experiment or efficiency/correctness claim for the proposed automatic adapter follows from these sources.
existing_memglide_capabilities: deduplication and bounded context packing in context service
approved indexed complete-file source-only preload with current ignore/source verification
cheap source-only passthrough when off or caller explicitly has context
smallest_extension: Opt-in bounded deterministic task-to-file discovery adapter over existing index metadata, followed by the existing complete-file secure preparer; keep existing explicit-path interface and default bytes unchanged.
research_hypotheses: Candidate ranking should reuse existing lexical/symbol evidence rather than add a separate vector/model service by default.
File-level dedup and exclusion of source already actually present in the current prompt can remove redundant added bytes; historical hash receipts alone do not prove retained context.
Bounded resolved local dependency expansion can supply direct helper implementations but is not proof of complete dependency closure.
Early prequery bypasses may avoid discovery work; score-based postquery abstention avoids injection but still pays retrieval.
Use descriptive strong-evidence and ambiguity rules as opt-in heuristics, not calibrated probabilities or predicted actual savings.
Whole verified files are the initial treatment; symbol excerpts remain an explicit partial-evidence experiment, with strict subset/closure warnings.
rejected_for_default: RepoCoder iterative extra model-generation loop: conflicts with no selection model calls and can add latency/unstable iterations.
Repoformer fine-tuned selector: assumes model training/control, unavailable in a same-Codex wrapper.
Always-injected whole-repository PageRank map: possible off-task hubs and extra tokens; no measured local advantage.
Blind source omission from previous-session hash receipts: native compaction/retained source is not observable.
Treating BM25 score or fixed gap as calibrated relevance/completeness probability.
Claiming globally best architecture or transferring upstream percentage gains to Memglide.
evidence_notes: RepoCoder main experiment uses sparse Jaccard, and selected Appendix B reports dense UniXcoder comparable on its repository completion tasks; neither is a modern coding-agent benchmark.
RepoCoder limitations explicitly leave time efficiency outside scope and show later iterations can regress.
Repoformer Appendix C says score-based trial retrieval can retain performance with reduced injection, but no retrieval latency benefit when retrieval still runs.
Repoformer published speedups rely on a trained self-selective code LM and particular serving assumptions, not this adapter.
Aider map is an interface/selection example, not source fidelity or complete dependency proof.
SQLite BM25 returns negative scores, floors nonpositive IDF and saturates term frequency; lexical scores do not establish cross-channel calibration.
recommended_evaluation: Separate development tasks from fresh held-out formal tasks and exclude hidden grader/reference fixes from indexed checkout.
Use identical source starts/settings, balanced order/repeats, isolated environments, preserved failures.
A bare native Codex; B existing known-path preload; C automatic discovery with natural-language task and no supplied paths.
Measure selector time/CPU/bytes and bypass reasons offline first; actual native usage/correctness/cost-per-success only in approved formal run.
Include no-match/ambiguous/oversized/stale/changed/deleted/ignored/sensitive/symlink controls plus multi-file helper dependency tasks.
Freeze source, corpus, grades, model/config and prices before formal results; require explicit budget approval before large paid run.

memory_router_followup.decision: Keep automatic warm-memory injection disabled; preserve existing explicit memory preparation. No automatic memory code added.
production_reviewed: src/memglide/integrations/auto_preload.py: no memory selection or model calls
locally_verifiable: Exact submitted claim version and whitespace-normalized exact deduplication
Cited source hashes match secure current source under current policy
Literal claim/quote duplication in actually delivered source bodies
Explicit caller acknowledgement of a claim version
not_proven: Semantic correctness or source entailment of a caller-saved rule
Semantic novelty merely because its words do not appear in selected source
Task usefulness, avoided investigation or positive cost/latency tradeoff
Current retained native context from an old receipt/thread ID
Complete file delivery from passport selected_files alone
memory_router_followup.important_passport_scope: ContextEngine._build_passport merges actual source-item hashes and selected memory source references into selected_files/verified_source_hashes. A passport path is not proof that a complete source body was delivered; inspect the actual delivered source envelope/items and ranges.
memory_router_followup.existing_ranker_scope: Memory selection uses lexical overlap, freshness and caller category bonuses. verified_fix is a caller-supplied category, not a semantic verification result. Provenance is validated bounded free text, not executable proof.
memory_router_followup.latency_source_interpretation: Official guidance separates input shortening, output generation and request roundtrips. Its numerical examples are general heuristics, not predictions or measurements for Memglide. A local source compiler should be evaluated on eliminated investigation and complete-task costs, not added bytes alone.

next_experiment.first: Offline shadow-only candidate audit: report proposed single rule, exact duplication, ownership/freshness, task lexical relationship, added bytes and selection cost without injecting. Include paraphrase duplicates, unrelated Current claims, misleading verified_fix labels, changed/ignored source, ended/expired sessions and passport-reference-only controls; independent semantic labels remain grader-only.
next_experiment.proposed_pilot: Four fresh related two-task sequences across at least two Python and two TypeScript repositories, source-only versus the same source policy plus at most one caller-verified finding, two repeats, balanced order: 32 original assignments. No rule may be chosen using hidden grading or future reference fixes; preserve all fallbacks and failed attempts.
next_experiment.cost_scope: Include first-task production of findings, capture/verification, selection, extra input and full follow-up task cost; no extra selector LLM. Sessions must remain the same still-active Memglide sessions, not new/ended/expired ones.
next_experiment.promotion: No strict-correctness/security regression; compare whole-sequence and follow-up cost per strict success and paired mean/median times with uncertainty. Do not promote from literal novelty or offline relevance labels alone.
